name: Hoop Session™
desc:
**THIS GAME IS IN BETA SO EXPECT BUGS**

🏀Welcome to Hoop Session, a MyPark style game!🏀

🏀Grind Your Overall to be the best!🏀

--🎮Controls🎮--

PC:
E - Increase Power
Q - Decrease Power
T - Dunk
H - Switch Hands
F - Behind the back right
G - Behind the back left
B - Fake behind left
V - Fake behind right
C - Crossover

XBOX:
Right Bumper/RB - Increase Power
Left Bumper/LB - Decrease Power
ButtonY - Dunk
DPadUp - Crossover
ButtonB - Behind the back right
ButtonX - Behind the back left
DPadRight - Fake behind the back
DPadLeft - Fake behind the back
Left Trigger/L2 - Switch Hands
